title: Serenade Italienne
identity: Planel's Sérénade italienne is Suite Romantique no. 1 for alto saxophone and piano, Leduc AL20246.

evidence.claim: A French music retailer identifies Sérénade italienne as an excerpt from Planel's Suite romantique for alto saxophone and piano.
An opened institutional catalog records the Suite romantique as six pieces for alto saxophone and piano, Leduc, 1944.

The Philharmonie de Paris ten-year saxophone guide describes no. 1, Sérénade italienne, as a slow recitative joined to a 3/4 serenade at quarter note = 160; listed duration 2:40. This is a guide description, not direct score inspection.
evidence.source_name: Philharmonie de Paris, Dix ans avec le saxophone

review_focus: Inference from the guide’s description: review the documented tempo/form contrast and articulation details in the score; no notation was inspected.
collection_flag: Original saxophone/piano work documented in a historical pedagogical repertoire guide. Specific college programming remains unverified.
